up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL376359 (ALOGLIPTIN) and all its salts, which have an IC50 bioactivity value in nM against target CHEMBL284 (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4). Use the molecule_hierarchy table to resolve the parent and all related salt forms. Follow the exact FAQ salts join semantics: first filter the compound set by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id for the parent and salts, then join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, join compound_records.record_id to activities.record_id, and join docs through compound_records.doc_id. Do not use activities.molregno as the activity join key and do not use assays.doc_id for the publication join. Return exactly the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH related_molregnos AS (
    SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL376359'
    UNION
    SELECT mh.molregno
    FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
    JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON mh.parent_molregno = md.molregno
    WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL376359'
)
SELECT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM related_molregnos rm
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = rm.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN assays ass ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = ass.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
